benchmarks.name: nsanku TTS Benchmark · 7 Ghanaian languages mean CER (GhanaNLP)
benchmarks.setup: nsanku TTS Benchmark (ghananlpcommunity/nsanku-tts-benchmark): 200 sentences per language in Dangme, Dagbani, Dagaare, Fante, Ga, Gonja and Akuapem Twi (Bible, JW, UNICEF, WAXAL, LDS, finance domains); each clip transcribed by a per-language ASR judge (KhayaAI/khaya-asr-v3 for five languages, Qlerqly/griot-nano-1 for Ga and Akuapem Twi) and scored by CER against the sentence. Unweighted mean of the 7 per-language CERs; per-language cells are provenance, not extra results. One entry per model: reference-audio (ref) mode where the model has one.
caveats: The benchmark makers (GhanaNLP) also make ghana-tts-72k and the Khaya ASR judge; their own model's row is by: lab.
Judge CER on real human speech is itself 4-26% per language (printed 'cer_on_real_speech'), so absolute values are high.
Equal-weight derived mean of printed per-language cells.
benchmarks.why_new: No existing id covers Ghanaian-language TTS; the Space (MIT) prints all 7 languages for three catalogue models (gemini-3-1-flash-tts-preview, omnivoice, ghana-tts-72k).
